description:
Hi Friends, 
 Hope you are doing great, 
 
 I have an urgent requirement from one of my esteem client, I will appreciate if you can have an eye on the below requirement and send me your updated profile ASAP 
 
 Position Title: Sr. Java Developer 
 Location: Washington, DC (Local and Nearby) F2F MUST 
 Duration: Nov 2016 – March 2017 
 
 The Java developer will participate in full lifecycle development using agile/scrum methodology of a multi-tiered JEE application. Developers need to work with business analysts, clients, and system users to understand and refine requirements and help in creating and maintaining system lifecycle artifacts such as requirements specifications, high-level architecture, and detailed system and application design documents. 
 Should Have: 
 · Experience with Core Java, Object Oriented Design & Principles, JEE 
 · Expertise with Spring and Hibernate Frameworks 
 · Experience with AngularJS, JavaScript 
 · Experience with PL/SQL and Oracle Database. Proficiency in writing stored procedures. 
 · Experience with designing REST APIs, Web Services. 
 · Should have working experience with WebSphere Application Server. 
 · Should have experience with dependency and build management tools like Maven. 
 · Should have experience in setting up & using continuous integration tools like Jenkins, Bamboo etc. 
 · Banking sector industry experience is preferred. 


 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. please send the profiles to alih (at)usmsystems.com and contact No# 703-955-3955
